drivers.name: Construction Management project charge
drivers.last_report: $337M pre-tax charge; delayed completion; substantial completion expected Q2 FY2027; claims recovery likely years/litigation.
drivers.guidance: Substantial completion expected Q2 FY2027; FY26 FCF ~$300M reflects charge.

drivers.name: Net service revenue growth
drivers.last_report: Q3 NSR $1,609M, -16%; ex-charge $1,946M, +2%; design +4%, Americas +6%, International +4%.
drivers.guidance: FY26 total NSR $7.30-$7.35B; ex-charge $7.65-$7.70B; lower growth due CM starts, Middle East conflict.

drivers.name: Margins excluding CM charge
drivers.last_report: Q3 ex-charge segment adj op margin 16.5%, adj EBITDA margin 17.0%, both -60bps; Americas 18.0%, -250bps; International 14.3%, +240bps.
drivers.guidance: FY26 ex-charge segment adj op margin 17.0%, adj EBITDA margin 17.4%; long-term 20%+ margin exit by FY2028.

drivers.name: Backlog and book-to-burn
drivers.last_report: Total backlog +13% to record $27,816M; record $4.2B wins; 1.6 book-to-burn; design 1.6; Americas 1.8; International 1.4.

drivers.name: Cash flow and FCF conversion
drivers.last_report: Q3 operating cash flow $95M, -66%; FCF $55M, -79%; strong ex-CM; net leverage 1.5x.
drivers.guidance: FY26 FCF ~$300M; long-term 100%+ FCF conversion once CM headwinds subside; near-term capital allocation to organic growth and dividend.

card.guidance: FY26: adj EPS $3.95-$4.15; adj EBITDA $935-965M; NSR $7.30-7.35B; FCF ~$300M. Ex-CM charge: NSR $7.65-7.70B; segment adj op margin 17.0%; adj EBITDA margin 17.4%; adj EPS $5.90-$6.10; adj EBITDA $1,275-1,305M. Long-term: 20%+ margin exit by FY28; 15%+ EPS CAGR FY26-29 ex-charge.
